correctness.rationale: The unique differing alternating interval, proven in the deletion-intersection literature and reconstructed in RESULT.md, bijects graph edges with marked D-first alternating factors. The flip preserves all ballot heights. Prefix P_h=C(z²)T^h and suffix F_h=(1-T^(h+1))/(1-2z) are proved by Catalan decomposition and first-passage splitting; summing gives exact series. Algebraic singularity transfer gives the constants. Independent deletion-set enumeration n=2..10, factor DP and formal power-series calculations n<=60 agree. Unbounded validity rests on proof, not tests.

value.rationale: The binary ballot-prefix language is a natural constrained stack/channel source. The result provides exact all-n edge counts and a structurally meaningful within-terminal-height versus between-neighboring-height split. Its limit gives 2:1 relative edge frequencies and average ambiguity degree asymptotic to n, information not contained in unrestricted estimates. This is an all-length motivated graph invariant and is not an arbitrary finite census.
